premises.text: Most of the global workforce is deskless and current systems leave over half of them with unresolved issues
premises.evidence_span: More than 50% of these deskless workers are having issues with the current system

premises.text: Text-message two-way portal gives workers easy access without installing another app
premises.evidence_span: Deskless workers don't need another application on their phone

premises.text: Employers get visibility and tools to engage frontline workers and see what each side is doing
premises.evidence_span: ANTIL provides employers with the tools to engage with their deskless workers and the transparency to see what every side is doing

premises.text: Custom sentiment and psychometric analysis lets employers learn feelings and needs before serious problems arise
premises.evidence_span: We also created a custom sentiment and psychometric analysis so that the employers will learn the feelings and needs of their desk-less workers before they say something

premises.text: High turnover is costly and stems from workers not being heard

value.text: Don't lose deskless workers—know what is going on and keep them connected
